name: hud_ui_mgr_map_replicated_screen_to_render_point
description: HudUiMgr::MapReplicatedScreenToRenderPoint maps replicated display coordinates into render-section coordinates and clamps them to render bounds.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x4089c0 validates the replicate-mode guard, x halving, y display-origin adjustment and halving plus render-origin addition, and final zOpt_ViewRectSection::ClampPointToInclusiveBounds call.

The viewport activation smoke verifies no-replicate no-op behavior, replicate coordinate mapping, and clamping through HudUiMgr::ScreenToWorld. The reticle smoke exercises the helper in the reticle mode-2 path.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x4089c0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a HUD manager/source-cluster pass.
